text: This report summarizes the changes impacting the City of Toronto (the City)'s obligatory reserve funds (deferred revenues), and reserves and Council-directed reserve funds (accumulated surplus) as at December 31, 2020. The City's deferred revenues (obligatory reserve funds) and reserves and Council-directed reserve funds (accumulated surplus) are subject to annual changes based on funding contributions, transfers, and drawdowns, which are authorized by legislation, third-party agreements, and Council's approvals. The tables and appendices reflect information by major category. As at December 31, 2020, the City recognized $7,585.8 million of deferred revenues (obligatory reserve funds) and reserves and Council-directed reserve funds (accumulated surplus), which consist of the following balances: - committed funds for legislated, contractually bound or Council-directed activities…
